notes.title: Coach and Personality Update + 4 new DLC races!
notes.content:
Personalities 
Coach and player personalities will have a greater impact on the game.  The biggest change is in game Buffs and Debuffs by players and coaches.  Coaches will attempt to buff each player on the field at the beginning of the game and again at halftime.  Depending on the coach’s personality and their compatibility with the player this can be positive, negative or simply fail to do anything.  

Players will also have an opportunity to buff each other at the beginning of the game based on their personality and compatibility.  Trash talk from players or coaches can also cause buff attempts (even if you have the trash talk dialogue turned off these buff attempts will still occur).

Compatibility is now shown on the roster screen to give a little insight into how well the players fit with each other and the coach.

If you don’t like the new buff mechanic by players or coaches, each can but turned off in the Mod Editor.  Simply drop the value of base buff amount to 0 for either coaches or players.
Hidden player likes and dislikes (4 of each) have also been added to players and coaches which increases the complexity of compatibility.  These can be based on player ratings, personality or even race.

Captains
Captains now added to the game.  The default captain selected is based on leadership of the player and their compatibility with the other starters.  The captain can be reassigned in the roster screen.  Captains will have 3 opportunities to buff at the start of the game (instead of 1) and they get a bonus to chance to buff and buff success.  WARNING: If your captain doesn't get along with teammates or has a bad personality they also have an increased chance to de-buff.

Coaches
Coach cards have been added to the game.  Removed the draft preferences from the coach screen (it is now hidden) and added stats for buff success or failure.  Reduced the amount that coaches ask for in raises. 

After halftime the coach will now evaluate how many yards per run vs how many yards per pass their team is gaining.  If there is a big discrepancy between the two, the coach, depending on their personality, will adjust the % of runs called vs pass.  Player ability will still be the most important factor, but this allows for some adjustment by the AI depending on team success.

4 new races added to the DLC and new racial variants added.

If you own the DLC you will now get 4 more races.  This brings the total to 22.  New variants added to many of the races base game and DLC.

Avian - These predators have sharp claws that allow them to latch onto other players and the ball.  This makes them excellent defensive players, especially at the cover position.  Avian tend to work hard, but are rarely cheerful.

Ursine - These large bear-like players, have a combination of strength and avoidance to make them powerful runners.  Shorter arms make tackling and catching an issue, so their defensive prowess suffers.  Ursine often are in a good mood and enjoy joking with teammates.  Much more interested in having fun than practicing.

Illithid - The least physically gifted players in all of brutalball.  Fairly average skills all around.  Illithid make up for this lack of natural athleticism by being unparalleled leaders.

Gnoll - The most naturally talented players in brutalball.  Can excel at nearly any position on offense or defense.  Gnolls often are the worst players in the locker room.  Easy to anger, they seldom like anyone.
Season ending injuries

Season ending injuries added.  
There is a base 5% chance for each injury to be season ending.  This can be set to zero in the Mod Editor.

Ratings Adjustments
Slight adjustments to calculation of many ratings (this doesn’t alter play on the field, just how the players are evaluated).  Main changes - RNR decreased impact of DOG slightly, drop ratings for one sided runners, changed durability effect for BLK - DUR no longer used to directly calculate BKR, but the steep drop below 70 DUR still is in place for BKR. upped STM for GNR, upped STR & SPD and removed AGL for CVR, increased STR for LBR, removed DUR for DLR and DLR will only start to plummet below 50 DUR.

Slightly adjusted calculation of defensive fantasy points for covers.

Default Mod Changes

Because of added mod variables and changes to the default settings the Default Mod settings all mods have been reset. Changes emphasizing more base injuries and more team training to get keep SR from creeping too high.  Also the number of end of week events has increased.

Old versions are saved in "Users\"YOUR USER NAME”\AppData\LocalLow \Stout Kassel Games\FFFL\Mods\DefaultFiles”.  If you need help restoring them, ask on steam or join the Brutalball Discord.

New Game Settings

Using the metric vs US standard system is now a toggle in game settings.  On the field yards and inches will still be used but the display of height and weight can now be toggled.

Added toggles to game settings for the export of rosters, events and retired players.  The first two are mainly for sharing if you are running and online multiplayer league.  The roster file is in an easier to read and manipulate format, without all of the extra players and unnecessary data.  

The retired players file is meant to be used to support a “College” system.  You can run a league with a short max career length (say 4 years) and export the retired players (RetiredPlayers.txt).  That file just needs to be renamed as ImportPlayers.txt and transferred to another league.  When that league starts a draft, those players will be used.  If the pool is too small, extra players will be generated.

Other
Many bug fixes and UI changes.  Some additional beards and hairstyles added.  Minotaur look improved and horns can now be a different color than the body color.

If you'd like to revert back to the old version (if you did a lot of editing for example), you can by going to “\Users”YOUR USER NAME”\AppData\LocalLow\Stout Kassel Games\FFFL\Mods\DefaultFiles" and deleting the "DefaultTeams.txt" or "ModConfiguration.txt" and renaming the most recent back-up version in that folder.

notes.title: College Update
notes.content:
College Games
A new tab was added to the tools menu to allow for optional  college all-star games with next year's rookies.  When clicking on College Games a new rookie draft pool will be created.  These players from the 77 colleges are sorted into 4 all-conference teams.  Stats will be kept for the players, injuries and kills will be permanent.  Once finishing the round robin play, you can reset the schedule and run it again.  Stats for players will continue to accumulate.  Because of the potential for deaths and injuries, 15% more players are created if you decide to run the college games.  Again this is optional and can be completely ignored.

View Draft Pool Stats and Abilities
In the stats screen you can now filter by rookies.  You can view their stats from the all-conference games and see their abilities.

Personalities may reset for rookies after draft
If the league has hidden draft pick potential activated, their will be a 50% chance that each rookie's personality will be re-rolled after the draft.  This allows for inaccuracy in the personalities discovered by observing trash talk during college games - with hidden potential no one knows how a player might change when they make it to the big leagues.

QoL
Added sim single game button.
Games speeds (if below 1.5) and zoom will be kept between games played in the same sitting.
UI altered to allow for longer names that don't break alignment of stats and roster screens.
Team names color coded on Team and Player Cards to make it easier to see how the team finished each year(Gold - won championship, Silver - lost championship, Bronze - made playoffs, Blue - didn't make playoffs).
Current Player Export feature - export of current players created in League Folder.  This allows for sharing team data easily between owners in multiplayer leagues.

notes.title: Trash Talk Update!
notes.content:
Players will now chatter during the games.  What players say is related to their hidden personality characteristics.  This gives more hints about player personalities.  Some things to look for in general:

High Greed - tend to brag about themselves
Low Greed - tend to be selfless
High Loyalty - tend to praise the team
Low Loyalty - talk about leaving or complain about team in general
High Dedication - Make comments about working hard
Low Dedication - tend to talk about being lazy and not wanting to work
High Reliability - tend to use boring tropes and broad comments
Low Reliability - say and do crazy things or talk about vices
High Acceptance - tend to compliment opponents
Low Acceptance - tend to trash talk opponents
High Morale - talk about excitement or uplifting things
Low Morale - make defeated comments or complain about team performance
High Leadership - try to inspire specific teammates or pump up team
Low Leadership - tend to insult or threaten teammates

Combinations of these are used and what players say about others is also influenced by personality and performance.

In the settings menu you can turn off trash talk and filter out profane trash talk.

notes.title: Appeal Changes and New Team Record Events
notes.content:
To make appeal a bit more dynamic and controllable the threshold and impact of the Leader or Cancer trait has increased.  The icons for these traits will now show how much of an appeal change this player is contributing to your team.  Dropping or adding these players to teams will immediately change the appeal of their team.

Team Record Events have also been added.  These events (which will appear after week 4) will check the current team record - 1 per week (random team).  Teams at the top of the standings will have a top player ask for more money.  Teams at the bottom of the standings will trigger a higher performing player to request a lower performing player be dropped or lose Appeal and Morale.  Teams in the middle will do a chemistry check amongst the players with the most fantasy points and either gain or lose 2 appeal.

Injuries will no longer cause a drop in DUR in the first 8 years of a player's career.

notes.title: End of Season Training Update

END OF SEASON TEAM TRAINING:  In normal league formats (Not Promotion/Relegation Leagues), teams that don't make the playoffs may earn extra training events depending on where they finished the regular season.  This was added to decrease the incentive for tanking to get a top pick.  Non-playoff teams that performed better the previous season tend to earn more end of season training events. notes.content:
Ratings changes listed below do not alter how the players perform on the field, just how they are evaluated by the AI

Blocker and DL rating was adjusted such that lower durability has a greater impact on their rating.  Linemen get injured far more frequently with low durability.  This change in the rating helps new players and the AI from putting low durability players on the line.

More Trade Value and Franchise Value tweaks.  Greater effect of age on these ratings - especially for players with double digit experience.

notes.title: Minor hotfix and Trade Value change
notes.content:
Rookies with hidden potential active, with now get their improvement before the AI trims the rosters.

Altered Trade Value calculation to incorporate more Durability like Franchise Value.  AI will now use Trade Value not Starter Rating to decide which players to keep when trimming the roster.

Decreased overall rookie salaries but increased salaries for the top players.  Net effect is top 15 will make more on average than before patch, which will continue to drop on average until pick 30.  Greed and starter rating will still play a role in initial salary.

notes.title: Hidden Draft Potential and Salary Change
notes.content:
Added an option to keep part of the rookie potential hidden (all rookie abilities lowered by 4 points but bumped from 0-8 post draft).  This option will be the new default but you can toggle this on the pre-draft screen.  The overall average quality post draft will be the same with either option.

Changed how Salary Rank is calculated.  Instead of counting the 8 starters, it will now TOTAL THE TOP 8 HIGHEST SALARIES.  This change will alter all leagues immediately.  This means you can no longer bench a high salary player to get rid of the cap hit.  This was unrealistic and led to people benching the top players to not only tank but reduce salary.

notes.title: Major Update 1.1 Tournament Mode and Player Cards
notes.content:
Update 1.1 Tournament Mode and Player Cards
Tournament mode – Ever want to match-up the champions from each of your seasons to see which is the best?  Want to match-up teams from different leagues or replay playoff games from previous seasons?  Now you can!

Tournament mode allows you to set up a tournament of up to 64 teams from any season and any league.  For Tournament creation just pick the tournament size 2,4,8,16,32 or 64, assign the teams and play!  Stats, Injuries and Deaths will be kept for the tournament, but they will not alter the original league.

Player Cards – A much requested feature.  Now you can finally see player stats for each season.  On the roster screen the “Edit Player” button has been replaced with a “Player Card” button which will take you to more detailed stats for the player.  Season breakdowns of the major stats for each season.  Along with more detailed reporting of events and injuries.  You will now need to go to the player card to edit the player.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44014611/705898dc5ccfc85c9715bca962fbc148f77228e4.png

Hover Info in Game – Now you can access a mini-player card during a game.  Simple pause the game (“Space”), then position icons will pop-up over the players.  Hover over these buttons to get a small player card with ability scores and historical fantasy point numbers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44014611/147f8f459e1e6526376d848489069525b5b3f4b7.png

Team Filter on the Stats Page – There is now a dropdown to filter by teams on the offensive and defensive stats pages.

Minor Passing adjustments – Runners with higher PASS will not be less likely to throw INTs and lower PASS will be more likely.  Also, faster Gunners are more likely to run deeper routes.  Disabled “Juke” move for receivers after the ball is thrown.  Since juke moves slow down the receiver, high agility receivers would occasionally be short on routes because they were performing a juke move.

Bounties - One losing team each week will be granted a bounty,  If the team places a bounty on a player their team appeal will drop by 1.  If they reject the bounty then they gain 1 appeal.

GREED - ask for more money.  Accept +1 APPEAL Reject -1 APPEAL
LOYALTY - will accept less money Accept lower coach salary Reject +1 Appeal
DEDICATION - extra practice Accept -1 APPEAL, Free Team Training Reject - nothing happens
RELIABILITY - cut budget Accept reduce Salary Spent by 500-1000 gp -1 APPEAL Reject - nothing happens

notes.title: Major Defensive AI Update!
notes.content:
Build 1.07: Defensive AI changes

The changes below have greatly reduced the number of “wide open” plays in both the passing and running game.  Overall yardage has dropped so defense and offense are more closely aligned in fantasy points.

Defensive Changes:

Changed LB cover logic. LB will better prioritize uncovered players. When deciding to double team a receiver the AI will now prioritize doubling the receiver with the most yards in the game.

AI should now take slightly better angles when trying to intercept ball carrier. 

Players away from the ball carrier will now go deep instead of trying to run through all of the blockers. This reduces the amount of extremely long plays with no defenders to challenge the runner.

Added larger variety of LB formations.  Also, there was a bug in which Contain wasn’t allowing LB to line up wide enough.

DL will now randomly rotate their spots.  No longer will the Best DL go again the best blocker.  The old method was allowing weaker DL and BLK to out perform the better players because they were always going against the weaker opponent.

AI should no longer continue routes outside the endzone or sideline. 

Rare "cut to the inside" bug when runner has open field should no longer occur. 

Trade Block chance for trade reduced from 50% to 33%.  

Due the improvement in coverage, the chance that the QB succeeds throwing into coverage was increased.

Bugs:
Fixed issue with picking teams in the league setup occasionally saying the team was already in the league when it wasn’t.
Fixed an issue with the arrows used to navigate the In Memoriam screen locking up when trying to cycle through the screen early.
Fixed issues with cycling Contain, Inside and Mixed when coaching manually.
Fixed championship wins sorting bug on the team stats screen.
Fixed various UI bugs

notes.title: Colleges, New Events and More!
notes.content:
Build 1.062

Adds EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS to the game (colleges, guilds etc.).  New players in the draft will come from one of 78 educational institutions.  Each institution specializes in 2 abilities (i.e. Strength and Brutality).  Players from those institutions will have a higher baseline than normal in those traits and a slight increase in their potential max at creation.  Already created players in current leagues will not have an educational institution assigned.

COACH TRAINING STAFF  Now each coach comes with a staff that has 2 specialties and 1 weakness.  These will be used in the new TEAM TRAINING EVENT.   Approximately 1/3 of the old player associated training events have been replaced with a team training event.  Instead of using player personality to determine which players improve, age is the primary factor.  During these events 3 abilities will go up more than usual – the 2 staff specialties and another random ability.  The staff weakness will not improve.  IMPORTANT:  these are balanced around how valuable the ability is, so for example SPEED is twice as valuable as VISION, so VISION will go up twice as much as SPEED on average.  This is intended to balance the training staff otherwise everyone would just look for coaches with speed specialty.

Current existing coaches will have training staff randomly assigned.

NEW EVENTS - CONTRACT CHANGES - players can now negotiate a new contract during the weekly events - this can go up or down.  If contract goes up you will have the option to drop the player.  This frequency is based on LOYALTY.  The amount of change is based on GREED.

LOYALTY BADGE change - now loyalty badges are based on the frequency of contract changes during weekly events.  Because of this change, ALL LOYALTY badges are reset to zero.

ABILITY VALUE ADJUSTMENTS:  Ran some data and make tweaks to the value of each ability.  NONE OF THE ABILITY’S PERFORMANCE IN THE GAME WAS CHANGED, only how the AI values them to calculate SR, FV, RNR, LBR etc.  Due to these changes the AI will realign the depth chart for each team.
Because of the adjustments listed above, each race had their values upon character creation changed.  So minor tweaks and nerfs to each.  The race most affected was celestials with about an 8% nerf to baseline stats.  All others were adjusted less than 5%. THIS ONLY ALTERS NEW DRAFTEES, current player abilities were unaltered.

Changed the impact of COACH DRAFT PREFERENCES. Coaches shouldn't pass up on superior talent as frequently due to draft preferences.

UI tweaks and tooltip adjustments.  
Fixed bug which caused issues when creating a new league using the same name as an old league.

notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.content:
In game subs weren't matching the new bench depth.  Should be fixed now.
Also, Kongans and Ratlings had incorrect Reliability ratings during character creation (too high).  Old players unchanged, but newly created players will use correct formula.

notes.title: Patch 1.059 - Depth Chart Improvement
notes.content:
Added more control of the depth chart:
Easily control the bench depth order by forcing players to the top of the bench
Now can force players NOT to play certain positions
Can force depth at each position - set RUN1, RUN2 RUN3 etc.

Fixed issue with recording season of player death.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Injury bug crash fix by adding "scrub" players to roster if roster size is less than 15 living (or undead) players when starting a match.

notes.title: Patch 1.057 More Logos, No Cap
notes.content:
Patch 1.057
Adds 20 new logos to the default teams.  Old default file will be backed up under “\Users”YOUR USER NAME”\AppData\LocalLow\Stout Kassel Games\FFFL\Mods\DefaultFiles" before overwriting with new default file.  If you want to revert to old file, simply delete the DefaultTeams files and rename backup file.

With the undead mechanic, it was decided to remove the ability and ratings CAP of 99.  Some players will now have ratings over 100 - new color for over 100 ratings and abilities.  These should be pretty rare in leagues with standard settings.

Changed how Blocker Rating (BKR) and DL Rating (DLR) are calculated.  Added DURABILITY to the calculations since linemen are more prone to injuries and death.  This does not change how they perform at those positions, just how the AI rates them and organizes the depth chart.

Added small chance for Rookies (0 years of experience) to get a stat boost after draft.

Added over 600 names to the name database.

Reduced the amount of salary increase Coaches demand when asking for more money.

Bug Fixes
Fixed issue with players catching the ball outside the back of the endzone.
Fixed rare bug with passes out of bounds causing loss of 2 downs.
Fixed a bug after injury causing game crash
Fixed bug with player becoming a coach, re-naming the coach to Player Prefab(Clone)
Fixed bug which showed incorrect losses on the Hall of Fame Screen
Removed option of 16 out of conference games with 16 and 24 team leagues.  This was never intended as an option.
Couple minor UI fixes and enhancements

notes.title: Hotfix 1.053
notes.content:
Fixed issue with randomize teams not working when league had multiple divisions
Fixed issues with Exit to Main Menu and Exit Match not functioning properly

notes.title: Undead Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44014611/a06cc4782cefb69a8fc999043013c14fe3954442.png

Undead Update - DEATH is not FINAL
Adds the undead to the base game.  At the end of the season all killed players have a chance to resurrect (10% default).  Resurrected players will come back as Undead.  Undead will come back with some stat variety - increased Strength, Stamina, Brutality and Durability at the cost of Speed, Agility and Dodge.  If an Undead player dies then that death is forever.

There is a small chance that some players in the draft will be Undead.

Other additions and fixes:
Added Height and Weight to the players
Added the ability to exit a match
Added the ability to slow down matches while simming - this will now turn on the player models and camera movement
Added randomize team(s) in the league setup screen
UI and stat screen adjustment.  Replaced showing drop% with total yards.
UI scaling adjustments to help when playing on ultra-wide screen - still not recommended, but more functional now
Fixed slow down of simulations that occurred as more seasons were played
Fixed bug with that prevented Game Settings from saving properly

notes.title: Patch 1.045 In Memoriam
notes.content:
Added In Memoriam screen at the end of season.  I recommend turning up the music for this one ;)
Added more player information on the Hall of Fame screen
Altered player card on roster.  Now only shows awards won and the awards are color coded
End of week news now shows human owned teams in yellow

Fixed issue with black screen at end of the regular season if an award winner was forced to retire early

notes.title: Patch 1.041 Trade Value
notes.content: Minor quick patch.  Added Trade Value to the roster screen.  This estimates the trade value of a player based on Starter Rating, Age, Salary and the number of positive and negative events that the player has participated in.

notes.title: Hotfix

notes.content:

notes.content:
Quick Patch

Fixed crash to desktop when hitting "Esc" or clicking game settings cog

If ball carrier has a clear path to the end zone the camera will now pan behind them

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Trade Block added!

Players can be added to the trade block from the roster screen.  During the weekly events, if any suitable candidates can be found, there is a 50% chance a trade offer will be made for each player on the trade block.  The AI balances trades based on starter rating, salary, positive vs negative events and experience.  The AI will not trade for players near retirement unless the AI team has a winning record.

Added coach of the year to end of season awards.

Bug fixes
Fixed playoff schedule issue with 32 team leagues and 0 divisions
Fixed bug which prevented a full rookie draft pool
Fixed bug not calculating team sack records properly
Fixed several bugs associated with exiting to main screen and creating a new league

Removed division names on the Standings Screen for Ladder leagues

Added ability to exit to main menu so you can switch leagues without quitting game
Added ability to scroll using mouse wheel on draft and stats menus
When opening roster from league menu the game will now go to the first Human controlled team
Coaches on teams will not retire unless that have 5 years minimum experience

Minor UI bugs

notes.title: Weather Update
notes.content:
Weather now in the game.  Can be set by for each individual team.  Weather and Special Events can be turned off in game settings.

Weather Conditions:

Rain decreases speed and catch chance, increases fumble and fall chance

Snow decreases speed, pass accuracy and catch chance, increases fumble and fall chance

Heatwave Increases stamina costs for all players

Frozen decreases pass accuracy

Fog decreases vision

Curse slightly increases injury chance.  Players that cause injuries will get an increase in strength, block, tackle and breakblock.  Lasts the entire game and is stackable.

Blessing will increase the stamina and durability of any player that scores a touchdown.  Lasts the entire game and is stackable.
